title: Bitumen Buyer Resources | Logistics, COA, Procurement FAQ
text:
INSIGHTS
PRACTICAL BITUMEN RESOURCES FOR BUYERS WHO NEED CONFIDENCE BEFORE PURCHASE.

These guides are written around real procurement questions: which bitumen grade to request, which documents matter, how packing affects landed cost, and how to move from inquiry to a qualified shipment.

BITUMEN LOGISTICS GUIDE
BITUMEN LOGISTICS & PACKAGING FOR IMPORT BUYERS

Packaging is a commercial decision, not a cosmetic one. For bitumen importers, the right format affects landed cost, unloading equipment, storage, safety, demurrage exposure, and whether the cargo can move through the selected port.

READ GUIDE
COA, PDS & SDS
TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS FOR BITUMEN PROCUREMENT

Technical documents help procurement teams qualify bitumen before commitment. PetroBind supports buyers with document-led supply: product data sheet for typical values, certificate of analysis for batch values, and safety data sheets for handling control.

READ GUIDE
BUYER QUALIFICATION WORKFLOW
PROCUREMENT SUPPORT FOR BITUMEN BUYERS

A serious bitumen RFQ needs more than a price. Buyers need grade clarity, document support, packing suitability, destination planning, and one accountable team willing to keep the transaction visible.

READ GUIDE
BITUMEN BUYER FAQ
BITUMEN SUPPLY FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Practical FAQ for procurement teams, contractors, distributors, and import buyers buying bitumen 60/70, oxidized grades, emulsions, and VG grades. Covers grade selection, packaging, documents, Incoterms, and how to structure a meaningful RFQ.

READ GUIDE
UNDERSTANDING BITUMEN PRICING
WHY BITUMEN PRICES MOVE — AND HOW BUYERS AVOID OVERPAYING

A bitumen quotation is not one number pulled from a price sheet. It reflects crude cost, refinery output, packing, freight, and — often overlooked — how tight regional stock is at the moment of quoting. Buyers who understand these drivers can judge a quote against the market.

READ GUIDE
STORAGE & HANDLING GUIDE
BITUMEN STORAGE & HANDLING FOR IMPORT BUYERS

Correct storage protects the value of a qualified shipment. Bitumen that is overheated, under-heated, or exposed to moisture during storage can lose the properties confirmed on its COA before it ever reaches a paving or roofing project.

READ GUIDE
GRADE SELECTION GUIDE
CHOOSING THE RIGHT BITUMEN GRADE BY APPLICATION

Bitumen is not one product — penetration grade, viscosity grade, polymer-modified, oxidized, and emulsion binders each suit a different application. Choosing the wrong family costs more than a bad price ever could, in rework or premature failure.

READ GUIDE
TERMINOLOGY EXPLAINED
BITUMEN VS. ASPHALT: WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE?

"Bitumen" and "asphalt" get used interchangeably in everyday conversation, but they aren't the same material. Buyers who confuse the two can end up requesting the wrong product from a supplier.

READ GUIDE
DOCUMENT LITERACY
HOW TO READ A BITUMEN CERTIFICATE OF ANALYSIS (COA)

A Certificate of Analysis (COA) is only useful to a buyer who knows what its numbers mean. This guide walks through the values most commonly reported on a bitumen COA and what each one tells you about the shipment.

READ GUIDE
MS 124 & JKR/SPJ REFERENCE
MALAYSIA PAVING STANDARDS — MS 124 & JKR/SPJ/2008 REFERENCE GUIDE

Malaysian road authorities specify paving-grade bitumen against MS 124 (the Malaysian Standard for penetration-grade bitumen) and the JKR Standard Specification for Road Works (JKR/SPJ/2008). This guide sets out, parameter by parameter, how PetroBind's sourced Bitumen 60/70 typical values compare — so a buyer's technical team can check fit before an RFQ, without relying on a claimed certification.

READ GUIDE
INSIGHT — CRUMB RUBBER MODIFIED BITUMEN
HOW RUBBERIZED ASPHALT IS MADE FROM MILLIONS OF OLD TYRES

Rubberized asphalt replaces part of the paving binder with crumb rubber ground from scrap tyres. The rubber does not go straight from the tyre to the road — it passes through a recycling plant that shreds, de-steels, grinds and screens it, and it is then reacted into hot penetration-grade bitumen. This insight walks through that chain and states plainly which bitumen grade sits underneath it.
